simple.meaning: בַּת רַבִּים (Bath Rabbîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “the daughter (i.e. city) of Rabbah.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בַּת רַבִּים (H1337) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בַּת רַבִּים (H1337) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בַּת רַבִּים (Bath Rabbîym) / H1337 is traced through Song of Songs 7:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1337. Bath -rabbim בַּתרַֿבִּים proper name, of a location ( daughter of multitudes ) appellation of populous city of Heshbon, or of its gate, Cant 7:5 (|| חֶשְׁבּוֺן ).
